# TimePicker

Built from the shared parts: the field is `FieldBox`, which owns the box, the border, the fill, the size and every state, same as DatePicker; the AM/PM menu in Trailing is the PLUS DropdownMenu. - **Typing:** the field takes an hour and a minute, with or without a colon. It is checked when you press Enter or leave the field: a real time (hour 1–12, minute 0–59) is picked, anything else is kept as typed and marked invalid, and `onChange` is not called. - **Value:** a 12-hour string, "02:30 PM". A 24-hour value given through `value` is split into the hour this control can show and the period that says which half of the day it is. - **AM/PM:** a separate toggle, since the field itself has no notion of one. Changing it reports immediately, with whichever half of the time is already set. Props it does not name (`aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `data-*`) go to the input, which is the control a screen reader lands on: TimePicker has no `label` prop, so that is how a caller names it.

**Import:** `import { TimePicker } from '@/components';`
